text:
Sorry the plant has had such a rough start. Losing about half its leaves counts as significant decline (more than a third), and at 10 days you're inside the 30-day guarantee (90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member). Submit a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant plus a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. If approved, you get one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock. The claim wouldn't be covered if you repotted it into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days, or if pests or neglect caused the decline.

For the cracked pot, damage reports are due within 48 hours of delivery, and the policy doesn't say what happens after that for a pot. I can escalate it to a Support Lead to see if anything can be done, if you'd like.
